name: PCB Camouflage (Dazzle / Test Mule)
description: Generate automotive prototype style dazzle / swirl camouflage patterns and manage silkscreen stashing.
description_full: A KiCad PCB Editor plugin that generates automotive prototype-style dazzle / swirl camouflage patterns on silkscreen layers while automatically avoiding component pads. It also provides seamless silkscreen stashing to unused user layers (searching backwards from User.9) and one-click restoration.
